title: B-tree cursor payload-size observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreePayloadSize returns the populated CellInfo payload byte count for the current valid entry, representing data size for table B-trees and key size for index B-trees.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller-held cursor mutex and native page-cell storage
dependencies.caller_closure: The observation lazily parses current table/index CellInfo and is consumed by the public virtual-table ValueList iteration path.

inputs: Valid Cursor under B-tree mutex with current page/cell storage
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Cursor; lazy parsing mutates only its cached CellInfo.
contracts.state_and_results: Returns CellInfo.payload_size exactly for table data or index key payload.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds cursor mutex; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid or malformed current cells return a typed local error before a payload consumer reads bytes.

representation_differences: The Zig owner returns its bounded typed error set while source relies on valid-cursor assertions and database corruption propagation around getCellInfo().

oracle.protocol: Populate a valid cursor CellInfo with payload size 23 and compare exact result.

assurance.oom: No allocation; lazy parse allocation is not part of this body.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid or stale CellInfo violates precondition.
assurance.continuation: Pure observation leaves cursor state unchanged.

integration.native_call_path: Public virtual-table IN iteration reaches lazy table/index CellInfo and native local/overflow payload reads.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. The populated-CellInfo-only substitute is retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires lazy CellInfo/caller integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/btree_core.zig CellInfo parse and cursor state owners were reviewed
callers: VDBE payload reads, incremental blob, and ValueList paths
Unit trace invokes the owner directly
callees: Source getCellInfo is represented by external populated-CellInfo precondition
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both source assertions and return block are assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream table/index payload, overflow, blob, and VDBE tests cover this observation
